props.name: children
props.description: TreeView content. Use a render function with `items` for S2 dynamic collections.

props.name: items
props.description: Dynamic hierarchical items. Supports either `id` or `key`, matching React Spectrum examples.

props.name: selectionStyle
props.description: Whether selection is shown with checkboxes or highlighted rows.

props.name: loadingState
props.description: Loading state forwarded to load-more behavior.

props.name: renderActionBar
props.description: Provides an action bar when items are selected.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: class
props.description: Backward-compatible class alias. Prefer UNSAFE_className for S2 parity.

props.name: slot
props.description: Slot name when used in a Spectrum context.

props.name: ref
props.type: HTMLDivElement | ((el: HTMLDivElement) => void) | { current?: HTMLDivElement | null | undefined; }
props.description: Ref for the tree root element.

props.name: label
props.description: Legacy label helper. Prefer aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: description
props.description: Legacy description helper.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique id for the tree.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Handler called when selection changes.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: ID of an element that describes the tree.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Label for accessibility.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: ID of an element that labels the tree.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the tree is disabled.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Handler called when expansion changes.

props.name: expandedKeys
props.description: Currently expanded keys (controlled).

props.name: defaultExpandedKeys
props.description: Default expanded keys (uncontrolled).

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: The selection mode.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: Currently selected keys (controlled).

props.name: defaultSelectedKeys
props.description: Default selected keys (uncontrolled).

props.name: onAction
props.description: Handler called when an item action is triggered.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Keys of disabled items.

props.name: disabledBehavior
props.description: Whether disabled items can still receive focus.

props.name: renderEmptyState
props.description: A function to render when the tree is empty.

props.name: dragAndDropHooks
props.description: Drag and drop hooks from `useDragAndDrop`.

props.name: isVirtualized
props.description: Whether the tree is virtualized.

props.name: keyboardNavigationBehavior
props.description: How keyboard navigation should behave within rows. `"arrow"` treats the tree as a single tab stop and uses arrow keys to move through row children. `"tab"` lets tabbable row children participate in normal tab order and stops child key events before tree navigation.

props.name: direction
props.description: The writing direction for the tree. Determines expand/collapse key mapping.

props.name: hasMore
props.description: Whether there are more items to load.

props.name: onLoadMore
props.description: Called when the load more sentinel becomes visible.

props.name: loadMoreClass
props.description: CSS className for the load-more sentinel.

props.name: renderLoadMoreItem
props.description: Renders the load-more sentinel content.

props.name: loadMoreStyle
props.description: Inline style for the load-more sentinel.

props.name: class
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: children
props.type: number | boolean | Node | JSX.ArrayElement | (string & {}) | ((props: { isExpanded: boolean; }) => JSX.Element)
props.description: Children to render inside the button.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique id of the TreeViewItem.

props.name: children
props.type: number | boolean | Node | JSX.ArrayElement | (string & {}) | ((renderProps: TreeItemRenderProps) => JSX.Element)
props.description: TreeViewItem content. Text-only children are wrapped in the S2 label slot.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether this item is disabled. Dynamic collections should prefer item data `isDisabled`.

props.name: hasChildItems
props.description: Whether this item has children that may not be loaded yet.

props.name: href
props.description: Link target metadata.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional description text. Prefer `<Text slot="description">`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon helper retained from the older Tree API. Prefer an icon child.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: class
props.description: Backward-compatible class alias. Prefer UNSAFE_className for S2 parity.

props.name: ref
props.type: HTMLElement | ((el: HTMLElement) => void) | { current?: HTMLElement | null | undefined; }
props.description: Ref for the rendered row element.

props.name: item

props.name: textValue
